config.hypothesis: With m2 fixed at 0.5, the N=64 to N=128 drop in trained force R2 is a lower ceiling, not slower convergence. Fresh seeds 22-23 (data_seed 0, 4 layers, d_model=64, e in [0, 0.5], best-of-3 controls) at N=128, trained to 6000 steps, stay at least 0.04 below the same seed's N=64 m2-fixed 3000-step trained force R2 (0.767 seed 22, 0.770 seed 23). Trained R2 is read from probes_final at the best-margin layer, unrounded, and that layer is reported. Within-run values are read as that layer's control plus margin, never from the max-over-layers trajectory field. Horizon check: if step-3000 trained force R2 differs by more than 0.03 from the 3000-step N=128 m2-fixed runs of the same seeds (0.654 / 0.631), the cross-run comparison is reported as horizon-confounded.
